UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile in the Kontrola app.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

points.description: Points awarded to the user for sticking to their budget.

fcmToken.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging token for push notifications.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether the user has enabled bill reminder notifications.

IncomeSource.title: IncomeSource
IncomeSource.description: Represents a source of income for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the IncomeSource entity.

name.description: Name of the income source (e.g., Salary, Freelance).

amount.description: Amount of income received from this source.

category.description: Category of the income source (e.g., Salary, Investment).

context.description: The financial context of the income, either personal or business.

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Represents an expense record for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Expense entity.

category.description: Category of the expense (e.g., Food, Transportation).

context.description: The financial context of the expense, either personal or business.

FinancialAdvice.title: FinancialAdvice
FinancialAdvice.description: Represents personalized financial advice for a user, generated by AI.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FinancialAdvice entity.

relevantIncomeSourceIds.description: References to IncomeSources relevant to this advice. (Relationship: FinancialAdvice 1:N IncomeSource)

relevantExpenseIds.description: References to Expenses relevant to this advice. (Relationship: FinancialAdvice 1:N Expense)

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: Represents a financial budget set by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Budget entity.

name.description: Name of the budget (e.g., Weekly Food Budget).

category.description: The category this budget applies to (e.g. 'Groceries', 'Overall').

SavingsGoal.title: SavingsGoal
SavingsGoal.description: Represents a savings goal set by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SavingsGoal entity.

name.description: Name of the savings goal (e.g., New Car Fund).

currentAmount.description: The current amount saved towards the goal.

currency.description: The currency of the target amount.

Bill.title: Bill
Bill.description: Represents a bill or recurring payment for a user.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to ensure authorization independence, clarity, and scalability for the Kontrola app. By employing denormalization and structural segregation, the design avoids complex security rules that rely on hierarchical data access, adhering to the principle of Authorization Independence (CRITICAL). User-specific data is segregated under the `/users/{userId}` path, providing secure and efficient data access. This design supports the required QAPs by structuring data to enable secure list operations and preventing rule-based filtering. The membership map is not applicable given that there are no collaborative entities. New `budgets`, `savingsGoals`, `bills`, and `linkedAccounts` collections have been added under each user.
